headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points and Nifty slipped below 25,400 amid broad-based sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Thursday, 26 November.

why: Indian stock markets are closed today, November 24, 2026, due to a trading holiday for Guru Nanak Jayanti.
In the previous trading session, Dalal Street witnessed a sharp sell-off wiping out over Rs 6 lakh crore in investor wealth.
Metal and banking sectors faced heavy selling pressure in Monday's session while IT stocks showed relative strength.
Concerns over potential new US tariffs created cautious sentiment across global markets.
whatHappening: Markets remain shut today for Guru Nanak Jayanti and trading will resume on Thursday, 26 November.
During Monday's session, the Sensex dropped 1,484 points while Nifty settled below 25,400.
Automakers including Tata Motors and Maruti Suzuki announced upcoming vehicle price hikes to offset rising input costs.
Pharma major GSK launched its new blood cancer drug Blenrep in the Indian market.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today, 24 November 2026, for Guru Nanak Jayanti and will reopen on Thursday, 26 November. On the last trading day, Sensex plunged 1,484 points and Nifty shed 451 points in a sharp sell-off. Key auto stocks like Tata Motors and Maruti announced price hikes due to rising input costs.
